**Summary of what the official page conveys (via its schedule table):** Each even-numbered Node.js major release follows this path: **Initial release** → **Active LTS** (≈18 months of active development with new features and fixes) → **Maintenance LTS** (≈12 months of critical fixes only) → **End-of-Life** (no further support).
